title: Integer complexes and localized maps for cup pairings
statement: For a scheme X and a nonnegative computing cup resolution D [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data], its integer complex is extension by zero along embeddingUpNat. Its derived augmentation is Q of the extended augmentation composed with the inverse single/extension identification, and is an isomorphism. For a resolution pairing D, Realizes t means that every nonnegative tensor summand of t acts on sections by D.pair through the extension identifications. D.derivedMap t is the composite of the tensor of the localized input augmentations, the lax tensor comparison [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], Q(t), and the inverse localized target augmentation. These are the unchanged constructions relocated from ModuleCupResolutionRealization.
